text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek has arrived at the Arima<n>Kinen
determined to make me the<n>best trainer in the
world.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
All at once, the entire crowd erupts<n>into cheers for
the both of us.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The stage is set for Super Creek to<n>put everything
we've trained for on<n>the line.
